title: Prepare a doctor's visit
description: A one-page brief to bring to the GP or specialist: current medications and recent changes, symptoms with dates, and the questions the family wants answered.
instructions: Prepare a brief the family can hand to a clinician in under two minutes of reading. Sections: 'Medications and recent changes' (name, what changed and when), 'Symptoms and observations since the last visit' (each with first date, how often it was noted, and any timing relation to a medication change), 'Daily functioning' (mobility, sleep, appetite, mood), 'What the family has already tried'. Then 'questions': 3-6 specific questions the family should ask. Cite note ids on every item. Do not interpret, diagnose or recommend treatment.
